question: You spot a tornado forming nearby...

options.text: Get into a small, windowless interior room or basement and cover yourself with something heavy.
options.explanation: Correct! This protects you from flying debris and collapsing structures.

options.text: Take shelter in your car, seatbelt on, and park under an overpass.
options.explanation: Cars and overpasses can funnel wind and debris — dangerous but slightly better than open ground.

options.text: Hide near the largest window to watch the storm’s path.
options.explanation: Windows can shatter violently during tornadoes — never stand near them.
